jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Programme - Planning Consultancy & Infrastructure Planning
jobs.description:
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives, while building a career as unique as you.


We are looking for graduates to join our Planning Consultancy or Infrastructure Planning teams in 2027\. This is an opportunity to work in a leading engineering and professional services consultancy, supporting clients to understand what is possible, navigate the planning system and bring forward places that respond to local needs .


**Opportunities are available in:**

**Planning Consultancy:** London, Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, Liverpool


**Infrastructure Planning:** Exeter, Edinburgh/Glasgow and Birmingham


**A little bit more about your role and the team…**

As a Graduate in our Planning Consultancy or Infrastructure Planning teams, you’ll help clients navigate the planning system and bring forward sustainable places and infrastructure that respond to local needs.


You will support multidisciplinary projects across areas such as housing, mixed\-use development, regeneration, social infrastructure, rail, energy, utilities and transport. From policy research and planning strategy to stakeholder consultation, consent applications and project delivery, you’ll build your understanding of the planning process while contributing to practical advice that helps deliver successful development and major infrastructure projects.


**To find out more about our teams, degree backgrounds considered and what your day\-to\-day activities could include, please visit our Graduate Website:** **Graduate schemes with WSP \| WSP**

**What we’re looking for**

* You will have, or be on track to achieve, at least a 2:2 in a relevant master’s degree. Please check the degree backgrounds considered for our graduate roles via our Graduate Website: Planning and Consents Graduate Opportunities \| WSP
* You will be looking to start work in September 2027\.
* You will be interested in planning, development, regeneration, infrastructure, policy, consents or engagement.
* You will be curious, analytical and motivated to support sustainable places and major infrastructure.
* You will enjoy collaborating and learning from planners, designers, engineers and environmental specialists.
* You will want to create value for clients and communities through clear advice and effective engagement.
* You will be keen to learn, take ownership and build your career across planning and infrastructure projects.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Should you have the right qualifications for our roles, apply and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities we have available for our Graduate programme.


**Our Graduate Development Programme**

Our two\-year Graduate Development Programme is designed to help you build the skills, experience and professional network needed to thrive at the start of your career with us. Through a blend of structured learning, mentoring and hands\-on project experience, you will be supported every step of the way.


**Application process**

Candidates must complete the application form in full, including all specific questions. If successful at this stage, you will be invited to complete an online assessment, containing a Cognitive Assessment, personality questionnaire and Situational Judgement Test (SJT). All stages are essential parts of our early careers’ recruitment process.


We review applications on a rolling basis and may progress candidates before the closing date, so we recommend applying as early as possible.

Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
  

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**
  
We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long\-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**

**Work\-life balance**

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.


Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Many planners never get to start a Local Plan from a blank page. We are about to. Chichester is preparing a brand\-new Local Plan under the reformed plan\-making system. It will decide where new homes, jobs and infrastructure go across one of the most beautiful, and most pressured, parts of the south coast. We want more planners to help make sure it is a success.



Our plan area runs from the harbours and coastline of the Chichester Harbour National Landscape and the Manhood Peninsula, around a Roman and cathedral city, and north beyond the South Downs to the Surrey border. Strong demand for housing, protected landscapes and wildlife, water quality and a changing coast mean the questions here are real, and the answers matter.



Planning is changing faster than it has for a generation, with a new National Planning Policy Framework, a new way of making plans and new strategic spatial development strategies. Local government in Sussex is changing too. With devolved powers comes exciting opportunities to influence at the strategic level and provide the infrastructure to deliver the required growth.


**You lead.** You will own whole workstreams of the new Local Plan, from evidence to examination: commissioning and steering consultants, drafting policy, taking reports to Cabinet and our Development Plan and Infrastructure Panel, and standing behind the plan as the Council’s witness at examination. You will put the Council’s voice to our neighbours’ plans and strategies, and you will manage and develop our Planning Policy Officers and Senior Planning Policy Officer.



You will be a qualified planner, eligible for RTPI membership, with a real track record in policy: drafting policies, dealing with representations and preparing examination statements, ideally with examination or inquiry experience behind you. You are confident with councillors, credible with developers and consultants, and you enjoy building a team as much as building an argument.



The post is open to job share applicants, and hybrid working is available.



For an informal discussion please contact Claire Potts on 01243 521274 or cpotts@chichester.gov.uk



Employee benefits include:


* Excellent defined benefits Pension Scheme
* Minimum 26 days holiday going up to 31 days after 5 years (or before with previous service) plus paid Bank Holidays – 31 days from day one at Grade G
* Flexi\-time (available for most positions) \- potential to build up an extra 13 days leave a year
* Flexible working arrangements including working from home and 9\-day fortnight options
* Employee Assistance Programme for staff and their relatives
* Cycle to Work Scheme/Car and Cycle Loan Scheme/discounted city centre parking/ Lease Car Scheme
* Health \& Wellbeing initiatives including free health checks and free eye tests plus subsidised leisure centre membership
* Payment of your main professional subscription fee
* Training and development opportunities – including funding of professional qualification training
* Staff Awards Scheme


Chichester District Council has a commitment to Equality of Opportunity in Employment. If you have a disability which makes it difficult for you to complete our application form please contact the HR team to assist you.

**ABOUT GMR MARKETING**

**We are** ***the*** **Experience Agency Making Unforgettable Stories Born of Humanity**


**NOT JUST EXPERIENTIAL.** ***EXPERIENCE.***



The lines have blurred. People live in the physical, digital, and social worlds all at once, and your brand experiences should do the same.


**NOT JUST TELLING.** ***MAKING.***



The best stories are lived, not heard. Make an immersive world for people to explore so they can experience something they'll never forget.


**NOT JUST CONSUMERS.** ***HUMANS.***



It all starts with the human. If you want to make a lasting impact, look beyond the wallet to understand what motivates and inspires people.

  

You see space differently. You understand that great 3D design is about more than what looks good on screen. It's about how a space feels, how people move through it, how materials behave, and how every detail comes together to create an experience. You can take an idea from conceptual sketches to production\-ready documentation, balancing creative ambition with the realities of fabrication, production, and installation.



You're not just a renderer. You're a creative partner who can shape the idea from the start. You know when to push a concept further, when to challenge the expected, and how to turn a strong creative direction into something people can actually experience. You bring a deep understanding of materials, spatial design, and the technical details that make ambitious ideas work in the real world.



Your 3D thinking helps shape more than individual projects. It helps shape entire campaigns. You'll work alongside Design Directors, Creative Directors, and production specialist, bringing your perspective to the table and pushing what's possible in spatial design. You're curious enough to explore what's next, skilled enough to make it real, and bold enough to rethink what 3D can do.



**REQUIRED SKILLS**


* **Lead the spatial vision.** You'll lead 3D design for major projects, transforming briefs into compelling spatial narratives that move from concept to built reality. You'll develop spatial systems, architectural concepts, and material palettes that can flex across environments, campaigns, and multiple brand touchpoints.
* **Make the vision feel real.** You'll create photorealistic renderings that capture the full experience, including lighting, materials, human scale, atmosphere, and brand narrative. Your work doesn't simply visualize an idea; it makes people believe in it.
* **Shape the creative direction.** You'll partner with Creative Directors and Design Directors to translate ideas into space, challenge assumptions, and push concepts into new territory. You understand that spatial design is more than aesthetics. It shapes how people move, interact, experience, and remember a brand.
* **Take ideas all the way to reality.** You'll move ambitious concepts into production through technical development, production documentation, fabrication, and installation. You understand what happens when a design leaves the screen and enters the physical world, and you know how to design for that moment. A deep understanding of materials, fabrication methods, environmental design, and real\-world performance is essential.
* **Build cohesive experiences.** You'll collaborate with 2D and Motion Designers to connect spatial design to the larger visual system, creating brand experiences that feel considered and cohesive from every angle.
* **Present with confidence.** You'll lead complex client presentations, communicate spatial concepts clearly, and make a compelling case for your creative decisions. You know how to bring people into the vision and take them along for the ride.
* **Master your tools and keep exploring.** You bring expert level proficiency in Cinema 4D, SketchUp, AutoCAD, and/or Rhino, along with experience using rendering plugins and AI enabled workflows. You also have strong command of Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Acrobat. You're curious about emerging technology and know how to use new tools to make the work smarter, faster, and more ambitious.
* **Own complex projects.** You have extensive professional 3D design experience in an agency, experiential, architectural, or related environment. You've managed projects from concept through fabrication and understand how to balance creative ambition with timelines, technical realities, and other real\-world constraints.
* **Bring a point of view.** You have strong spatial instincts, strategic thinking, and a portfolio that demonstrates conceptual depth, diverse project experience, and exceptional craft. Most importantly, your portfolio shows work that has actually been built.

---------------------


***Salary Range:*** $30\.5311 \- $35\.3398/hour. Salary reflects Step 1 and Step 4 of a 7\-step pay scale. Salary at hiring will be dependent upon the applicant's education, experience, and training.
  

  

***Work Schedule:*** Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
  

  

***Required Application Attachments:***

* Cover Letter
* Resume

***Job Summary:***
  

Under general supervision, performs intermediate to advanced spatial analysis, designs, configures, and maintains web\-based GIS applications and mobile field data collection workflows, manages spatial database quality control, builds task automation workflows, and provides technical support, analysis, and training to City departments; and performs related work as required.
  

  

***Scope*** ***of Responsibility:***
  

Incumbent works with moderate independence in applying established spatial principles, geoprocessing techniques, and analytical procedures. Working under general supervision, the GIS Analyst solves intermediate spatial problems, configures web GIS solutions, validates spatial data integrity, and supports municipal programs across multiple departments. The role frequently interacts with City employees across multiple departments, external agencies, developers, and consultants to gather project requirements, deliver analytical products, and explain procedural technical details.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------


**Spatial Analysis, Web GIS \& Application Configuration**  

  



* Perform intermediate and advanced vector and raster spatial analysis, geoprocessing, proximity modeling, and cartographic map production to support Public Works, Planning, Public Safety, Administration, and City Council initiatives.
* Configure, deploy, and maintain web\-based GIS applications, dashboards (e.g., Esri Experience Builder, ArcGIS Dashboards), and interactive web maps to meet departmental operational needs.
* Configure, deploy, and support mobile GIS applications (e.g., Esri Field Maps, Survey123, QuickCapture) for field data collection, asset inspections, and mobile workflows.
* Utilize Esri ModelBuilder and scripting (e.g., Python/ArcPy) to automate routine data transfers, geoprocessing models, spatial queries, and regular reporting.
* Perform advanced spatial data editing, attribute validation, and quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) on enterprise geodatabase layers, enforcing topology and attribute domain rules.
* Assist in maintaining relational database associations, table joins, relates, and domain lookups within enterprise geodatabases.
* Post\-process high\-accuracy Global Positioning System (GPS) field data and verify feature spatial accuracy before committing to enterprise layers.

**Cross Departmental Support \& Municipal Date Operations**
  

* Serve as a primary technical liaison for assigned City departments regarding spatial analytics, custom mapping requests, mobile solutions, and web app enhancements.
* Support municipal land records, parcel mapping, and addressing workflows; evaluate and process official addressing, street naming, and boundary adjustments in coordination with Planning, Public Safety/911, Yellowstone County, and State agencies.
* Collaborate with departmental staff to create new spatial layers for asset management systems (e.g., Cityworks) and ensure data integration across operational platforms.
* Extract, transform, and analyze spatial and attribute data from relational databases and external data sources for municipal decision\-making and open data deliverables.
* Provide technical support, training, and troubleshooting assistance to City staff on desktop GIS software, web apps, and mobile collection tools.

**GIS Division Operations and Support Functions**
  

* Assist GIS Specialists and Managers in maintaining metadata standards, dataset inventories, and comprehensive technical process documentation.
* Support data migration, schema updates, and dataset standardization across City departments to maintain system efficiency.
* Attend and participate in professional group meetings; stay abreast of new trends and innovations in GIS, spatial analysis, web mapping, and mobile data collection.

**Perform other duties as assigned.**
